\par\vspace{3pt}
{\footnotesize\raggedright E1 (SARIMA-sel-Y1): the order chosen by SARIMA-sel is refitted with data up to $Y-1$. In the original protocol all ten SARIMA-sel fits converge, so neither rule changes any published result. In E1 only one unit does not converge: sutil 2021, chosen order (2, 1, 0)(2, 1, 1, 12) (AIC rank 3 of 5). Rule 1: next order in AIC rank among the five preselected that converges: (0, 1, 0)(1, 1, 0, 12) (AIC rank 2). Rule 2: next order by validation MAE among those that converge (the protocol's selection criterion): (3, 1, 2)(2, 1, 1, 12) (AIC rank 1). The MAE in shock months does not change because the sutil 2021 window has no P75 shock month. Rule 1 is shown without CI (its forecasts were not stored; MAE from the round-2 day-1 analysis). Rule 2 keeps the protocol's selection criterion. MAE in tonnes; 95\% CI: paired bootstrap of months within each test window (B = 10,000, seed 42). All results in this table are post-protocol analyses (second review round) and do not modify the pre-registered ten-model ranking.\par}
